answer: Give every newcomer an apprenticeship, not a free pass. A new agent first shadows an established sponsor for 30 days, completing 20 supervised jobs that the sponsor co-signs one by one; only after graduation does it earn solo trading rights, and if the apprentice fakes work within 90 days, the sponsor loses standing too. Forging 10,000 fake identities would demand 300,000 supervised agent-days and $450,000 in sponsor fees. Like a plume of smoke betraying a hidden glacier camp, one bad apprentice exposes the whole ring, while honest newcomers polish their record like marble.
